extName.message: X (Twitter) Video Downloader – Save Videos, GIFs & Photos
extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and the Chrome Web Store

extDesc.message: Download X (Twitter) videos, GIFs and photos in one click, or a whole profile at once. Pick quality and folder; full history.
extDesc.description: Short extension summary (Chrome Web Store search-result text, max 132 chars)

popupTitle.description: Popup title and brand name; also the options page heading

popupOpenTweet.description: Popup link to the current tweet

popupEmpty.message: Open a tweet (or a timeline) that contains a video, then click the extension again.
popupEmpty.description: Popup empty state when the tab is not a tweet with video

popupEmptyTip.message: Tip: a Download button also appears under every video in the feed.
popupEmptyTip.description: Popup empty-state hint about the timeline button

popupViewAll.description: Popup link that opens the history page

popupQualityDefault.description: Popup quality option that uses the user's default setting

popupBatchDownload.description: Popup button on a profile Media tab

popupBatchStarting.description: Popup status while a batch is starting

popupBatchAlready.message: A batch is already running on this page.
popupBatchAlready.description: Popup status when a batch is already in progress

popupBatchStarted.message: Started. Progress stays on the page.
popupBatchStarted.description: Popup status after a batch starts successfully

popupBatchFailed.description: Popup status when a batch could not start

popupBatchReload.message: Reload the media page, then try again.
popupBatchReload.description: Popup status when the content script is missing

popupPreparing.description: Popup status while a single download is prepared

popupDownloading.description: Popup status after a download starts

popupFailed.description: Popup status when a download fails

popupUnknownError.description: Popup fallback when a failure has no message

popupRecentEmpty.description: Popup recent list when history is empty

popupNoCapture.message: No video captured yet. Scroll the video into view or open the tweet, then reopen this popup.
popupNoCapture.description: Popup status when the tweet is known but variants are not cached

popupVariant.description: Popup quality option for a captured rendition

popupVariantBitrate.description: Quality option when only bitrate is known

optionsStateInterrupted.description: History state: download failed or was cancelled

optionsClearDownloaded.description: History toolbar: clear the duplicate-detection index

optionsClearAll.description: History toolbar: delete all history rows

optionsHistoryEmpty.message: No downloads yet. Open X, find a video, and hit Download.

optionsQualityHint.message: Used by the popup and the in-timeline Download button. X serves a few fixed renditions per video; “closest below” picks the best one that does not exceed your target.

optionsQualityHighest.description: Quality option: best rendition X served

optionsQualityLowest.description: Quality option: smallest rendition X served

optionsFilenameTokens.description: Settings: label before the unlocalized {token} code chips on filename and subfolder hints

optionsFilenameHint.message: {text} is the first few words of the tweet; {datetime}/{date}/{time} use the tweet's own post time. .mp4 is added automatically; / nests subfolders. The default ({user}_{text}_{datetime}_{id}) is always unique — the tweet id prevents any collision.
optionsFilenameHint.description: Settings: filename template help text after the token chips. Keep {tokens} unchanged.

optionsSubfolderHint.message: Chrome extensions can only write inside the browser’s Downloads folder. A relative subfolder is the closest thing to “choose a path”. Leave blank to save straight into Downloads. To pick a location every time, turn on the option below.
optionsSubfolderHint.description: Settings: subfolder help text before the token chips

optionsSubfolderHintNest.description: Settings: subfolder help text after the token chips. Keep the / character.

optionsSubfolderPlaceholder.description: Settings: subfolder input placeholder; keep as a disk path

optionsAskWhere.message: Ask where to save every time

optionsAskWhereHint.message: Opens Chrome’s “Save As” dialog for each download so you can choose any folder. Overrides the subfolder above.

optionsShowButton.message: Show a Download button under videos in the timeline

optionsClickImmediateHint.message: When off, the button opens a small quality menu instead. (Alt-click always opens the menu.)

optionsMaxHistoryHint.message: Oldest history entries beyond this count are dropped.

optionsBatchShowingFrom.description: History banner when filtering by a batch id

optionsBatchShowing.description: History banner when the batch has no timestamps

optionsHistoryCount.description: History count of filtered vs all rows

optionsShowFile.description: History card action that reveals the file in the folder

optionsRedownloadStarted.description: History re-download button while the new download begins

optionsRedownloadFailed.description: History re-download button after a failure

optionsRemove.description: History card action that deletes the row

optionsConfirmClearAll.message: Delete all $COUNT$ history entries? This does not delete downloaded files.

optionsConfirmClearDownloaded.message: Clear downloaded records? Previously saved media will be downloaded again. Files and history are kept.
optionsConfirmClearDownloaded.description: Confirm dialog before clearing the duplicate index

optionsImportOk.description: Alert after a successful history import

optionsImportFailed.description: Alert after a failed history import

optionsFolderDownloads.description: Fallback folder name when a file is saved at the Downloads root

toastDownloadAgain.description: Toast retry button tooltip and aria-label

toastPreparing.description: Toast shown while a timeline download is prepared

toastAlready.description: Toast when this media is already in the downloaded index

toastNoImage.message: Could not find a downloadable image for this tweet
toastNoImage.description: Toast when an image download fails with no extra error

toastNoVideo.message: Could not find a downloadable video for this tweet
toastNoVideo.description: Toast when a video download fails with no extra error

toastNoImageError.message: Could not find a downloadable image for this tweet ($ERROR$)
toastNoImageError.description: Toast when an image download fails with a reason

toastNoVideoError.message: Could not find a downloadable video for this tweet ($ERROR$)
toastNoVideoError.description: Toast when a video download fails with a reason

toastDownloading.description: Toast after a single-file download starts

toastDownloadingImages.description: Toast after a multi-image download starts

toastFileFallback.description: Toast fallback when the download has no filename yet

toastErrTombstone.message: This post is not visible to the public API, so the fallback could not read it. Reload the page with the video on screen and try again.
toastErrTombstone.description: Error when syndication returns a tombstone

toastErrHls.message: X only provides this video as a streaming playlist (HLS), which cannot be saved as a single file.
toastErrHls.description: Error when the video has no progressive MP4

toastErrNoVideo.message: No downloadable video found for this post.

toastErrNoMp4.description: Error when captured variants include no mp4

toastErrNoImages.description: Error when an image download has no URLs

toastErrImagesFailed.description: Error when every image in a set failed to start

toastErrHistoryGone.description: Error when re-download cannot find the history row

toastErrSyndication.description: Error when the syndication request is not OK

toastImageLabel.description: Download label for an image set, shown in popup status

menuDownloadImages.description: Quality menu title for a multi-image post

menuDownloadImage.description: Quality menu title and timeline button aria-label for an image

menuDownloadVideo.description: Quality menu title and timeline button aria-label for a video

menuHighest.description: Video quality menu fallback when variants are not captured yet

tipDownloadVideo.message: Download video · right-click to pick quality
tipDownloadVideo.description: Timeline button tooltip for a video

tipDownloadMixed.message: Download video and images · right-click to pick quality
tipDownloadMixed.description: Timeline button tooltip for a post with video and images

ariaDownloadMixed.description: Timeline button aria-label for a post with video and images

tipDownloadImage.message: Download image · right-click to pick quality
tipDownloadImage.description: Timeline button tooltip for an image

batchStop.description: Batch panel stop button tooltip and aria-label

batchContinue.description: Batch panel continue button tooltip and aria-label

batchHistory.description: Batch panel link to filtered history

batchFolder.description: Batch panel link to the last downloaded file

batchFinished.description: Batch panel status when the run completed

batchStopped.description: Batch panel status when the user stopped the run

batchRateLimited.description: Batch panel note when X returns 429 or error 88

batchCapped.description: Batch panel note at the 500-file cap

batchSkippedFailed.description: Batch panel note after a finished run that skipped or failed some files

batchResume.description: Batch panel toggle tooltip while paused

batchPause.description: Batch panel toggle tooltip while running

batchNeedMediaTab.message: Open a profile Media tab first.
batchNeedMediaTab.description: Error returned when batch start is not on /media
